lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 10-11 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible across the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-section but becomes progressively tighter as the lines approach the posterior haunch.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fourth line from the anterior, splitting near the dorsal ridge. Most other lines maintain a singular, non-intersecting vertical trajectory.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 1 and 2 at the anterior transition from the neck are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral fringe. Line 10 near the posterior is a dashed segment that does not reach the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5-6 high-contrast spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated in the posterior-ventral quadrant of the haunch mass.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct spots align in a semi-connected horizontal geometric line across the mid-thigh, parallel to the ground plane.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate curve; they emerge from the frontal bone with an initial lateral-posterior sweep before curving medially and terminating in an upward-facing apical vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the two terminal tips is approximately 2.3 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The high-contrast ivory-colored tips occupy approximately 0.15 of the total vertical length of the visible horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron-like spots on the lateral muzzle and cheek area; prominent white-tipped dorsal mane; distinct orange/tan coloration on the lower limbs starting at the carpal and tarsal joints.
